description.value: A 24/7 convenience store and fuel station on Southeast Marine Drive in South Vancouver, part of the global 7-Eleven chain. It offers a full range of grab-and-go foods, hot roller grill items, espresso, Slurpee drinks, and an ATM, making it a reliable any-hour stop for cyclists needing to restock. The on-site fuel station also sells diesel.

address.value: 688 Southeast Marine Drive, Vancouver, BC V5X 2T4
